verdict.rationale: Mozilla.ai docs explicitly provide pre-built llamafiles that require no compilation—just download, make executable, and run—corroborated by extensive community hands-on reports of running the prebuilt binary immediately on Linux/Windows/macOS without building from source. missing for 10: no evidence of distribution via standard OS package managers (apt/brew/winget), and community notes real caveats like Windows 4GB executable size limits and occasional platform failures (e.g., NixOS).
